blocks.x: Claims triage in minutes — 55% faster cycle times with document intelligence
A top-5 global P&C insurer — Insurance & Risk engagement delivered by a 26-person team over 16 months, Global scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: FNOL packets, estimates and medical files arrived unstructured; triage queues held claims for days.
Straight-through rates below 20% on simple claims; adjusters spent time typing, not deciding.
Fraud signals arrived after settlement; SIU capacity wasted on low-value leads.

blocks.x: We deployed the claims decision pipeline: document intelligence (classification, extraction, validation) feeding Achala Nexus decision policies with confidence-threshold routing, network fraud analytics scoring claims pre-settlement, and a portfolio lakehouse unifying exposure and claims for steering. Adjusters work a review queue of pre-assembled cases with citations.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: KYC refresh backlog cleared — 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly
Case processing down 52% — document intelligence under accountable-AI gates

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Applied AI & Generative AI, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: Achala Swarm, Achala Nexus, Achala Forge.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
